Tinkatuff

Fairy Steel

Paldea · Generation 9

Tinkatuff is a Fairy/Steel-type Hammer Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 59.1 kg. It evolves from Tinkatink and into Tinkaton. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (82), with a base stat total of 380.
